map.HLH-2004 标准：8 项（①发热≥38.5℃>7天；②脾大；③≥2系血细胞: HLH-2004 criteria: 8 items (1. fever >=38.5 C for >7 days; 2. splenomegaly; 3. cytopenia in >=2 lineages; 4. triglyceride TG >=3.0 or fibrinogen <1.5; 5. hemophagocytosis; 6. low NK activity; 7. ferritin >=...
map.发热+肝脾大+血细胞减少等，按 HLH-2004 八项标准逐项核对: Fever plus hepatosplenomegaly plus cytopenia, checked item by item against the eight HLH-2004 criteria
map.看达标项数（≥5）或是否检出已知致病基因突变: Look at the number of items met (>=5) or whether a known pathogenic gene mutation is detected
map.高度可疑但不足 5 项时不应等全部达标即开始治疗: When it is highly suspected but fewer than 5 items are met, treatment should not wait until all are met
map.铁蛋白极高（>10000 μg/L）强烈支持 HLH 且病情重，常伴严重噬血与高: Very high ferritin (>10000 ug/L) strongly supports HLH and indicates severe disease, usually with marked hemophagocytosis and a severe cytokine storm; but the other criteria are still needed, and no single marker can make the diagnosis.
map.基因突变阳性但不足 5 项算 HLH 吗？: If the gene mutation is positive but fewer than 5 items are met, does it count as HLH?
map.算。原发性（家族性）HLH 若检出已知致病基因突变，即使临床项不足 5 也可诊断: Yes. Primary (familial) HLH can be diagnosed if a known pathogenic gene mutation is found even when clinical items fall short of 5 (molecular diagnosis); such patients usually need allogeneic transplantation for cure.
